close_boundary.contract: Private Darwin close(int), consumed by safe close_checked(OwnedFd) -> io::Result. IntoRawFd transfers ownership; close is called exactly once, errno is read immediately after failure, and the descriptor is never retried or reconstructed.
close_boundary.unsafe: Only the new native call and immediate errno read are unsafe. Each has a local SAFETY comment. Existing entropy, UID, and peer-credential bodies are unchanged.

security_limits_and_ownership.path: Byte paths are 1..=1023 bytes, contain no NUL, and are converted only after bounds validation. New-file final components cannot be empty, . or ...
security_limits_and_ownership.temporary: Sibling names retain the legacy .vexel-save- and .vexel-new- prefixes and six-character suffix lengths. Six SecRandom bytes generate the suffix; OpenOptions::create_new(mode 0600) makes reservation exclusive. Candidate construction uses checked lengths and fallible reservation.
security_limits_and_ownership.replacement_target: symlink_metadata rejects symlink/nonregular targets. Open uses the Darwin O_NOFOLLOW flag, then file metadata dev/ino must match the initial lstat equivalent. Existing mode 07777 is applied before file sync.
security_limits_and_ownership.commit_and_cleanup: Data and mode sync precede consuming checked close. Replace commits at rename; create-new commits at hard_link. Precommit failures close and remove the temp; create-new removes its extra link after commit. Directory sync results report postcommit state without rollback.
security_limits_and_ownership.payload: Input data is borrowed and streamed without a payload copy; empty data is supported. No new dependency, C shim, public raw descriptor API, or unsupported-OS code was added.

hook_contract.adaptation: Legacy replaceable operation hooks are adapted to safe before-operation fault/observation hooks. Returning Ok cannot report that an operation completed: native write, file sync, consuming checked close, rename, hard link, temporary unlink, and directory sync always execute in the operation path.
native_operations: directory File::sync_all followed by consuming checked close
hook_contract.failure_model: Injected hook errors skip the gated operation and exercise the corresponding reported failure state; tests do not claim these are native syscall failures. Short-write limits and Interrupted hook errors still exercise the native write loop.
